data.title: HGTC Area Commission Selects Dr. Lori Heafner as College's Next President
data.description: In today's announcement from Conway, South Carolina on September 18, 2026, it has been revealed that Lori A. Heafner, Ph.D., has been chosen as the new president of Horry-Georgetown Technical College (HGTC) by the HGTC Area Commission after an extensive search across the nation. This decision marks a significant milestone for the college and the community as Dr. Heafner takes on this leadership role.

data.title: Grupo Bimbo Recognized as One of TIME’s World’s Best Companies
data.description: Based in Mexico City, Grupo Bimbo, the world's top baking company, has earned a notable honor by being featured in the prestigious World’s Best Companies 2026 list. This recognition marks their third inclusion in the ranking, compiled by TIME in collaboration with Statista. Recognized as the largest of its kind globally, Grupo Bimbo continues to make an impact on the industry.

data.title: Binance introduces 24/7 FX perpetual futures with weekend pricing, joining other exchanges in offering continuous foreign exchange market access.
data.description: Binance has joined the increasing number of cryptocurrency exchanges providing 24/7 access to the foreign exchange markets through perpetual futures contracts.

data.description: Roundtable has announced that it will not be acquiring PAAI as a private stock sale is a prerequisite for the deal to go through. The partnership between the two companies is set to generate a significant ad ecosystem worth $100 million, with RTB Enterprise Partners expected to benefit from a margin of 40%.

data.title: Fathom Statement on Governor Newsom's Executive Order to Accelerate Independent Verification of AI
data.description: Governor Newsom of California has accelerated the implementation timeline for SB 813, the initial all-encompassing independent verification law in the country. The order also assembles national specialists to explore areas where independent verification could have a greater impact. This move was made on September 18, 2026, in Sacramento.

data.title: Calavera New York Unveils Redesigned Website, Expanding into Fine Gemstones, New Jewelry Categories, and AI-Powered Shopping
data.description: A recent launch of a new platform in New York provides shoppers with access to a vast selection of over 2 million diamonds and gemstones, along with a variety of new jewelry styles and bespoke design services. This platform also offers the assistance of an AI Gemologist to assist customers in making informed purchases. The platform belongs to Calavera New York, a renowned diamond retailer and jewelry brand located in Manhattan. The platform was unveiled on September 18, 2026.

data.title: Portland Craft Chocolate Festival Returns Oct. 2-4 with 45+ Oregon Makers -- and 300+ Entries for Portland's Best Chocolate Chip Cookie
data.description: The Ranger Chocolate Co.-sponsored second annual festival in Portland's Central Eastside is set to be bigger than ever. Highlights include the C⁴ Chocolate Chip Cookie Competition, a collaboration between Steven Smith Teamaker and Ranger Chocolate Co. introducing new bonbons, as well as offerings from Stumptown Coffee Roasters. The event will also feature a variety of family-friendly activities throughout the weekend, making it a celebration not to miss.

data.title: She Learned to Fly at 49. Now She Wants the Next Generation of Girls to Look Up
data.description: An owner of a flight school in Sedona, Arizona is urging girls not to avoid flying. On September 19, 2026, International Girls in Aviation Day will be celebrated for the 12th year. This day promotes females of all ages to explore flying.

data.description: In Los Angeles on September 18, 2026, Kobold Press participated in an episode of "All Access with Andy Garcia". The feature will delve into how this practice fosters literacy, teamwork, and community values.

data.title: AI Agents Are Influencing Product Decisions Without Explicit Human Authorization, Warns Info-Tech Research Group
data.description: According to recent findings from Info-Tech Research Group, implementing a product-centric delivery approach enables organizations to preserve value beyond individual projects by upholding ownership, direction, and accountability throughout the product lifecycle. This methodology emphasizes maintaining a focus on the product itself rather than project-based milestones. The research highlights that artificial intelligence (AI) agents are introducing fresh governance challenges to this approach. The study underscores the importance of adapting governance strategies to effectively manage AI agents within the product lifecycle to ensure optimal outcomes.

data.description: On September 4th, in Sag Harbor, New York, the event hosted by Kidd Squid Brewing Co. attracted a large number of attendees. NBA Champion Josh Hart made an appearance at the event. data.title: Uber will compensate $40M to family of Emily Normandin-Parker, 23, who died after being hit by a car when asked out of Uber in CA.
data.description: A 23-year-old woman named Emily Normandin-Parker tragically lost her life on a California freeway in August 2023. The incident occurred after an Uber driver forced her and a friend out of his vehicle, leading to her death in the unfortunate event.

data.title: Future of STEM Scholars Initiative Opens Applications for 2027 STEM Scholars
data.description: A program is commemorating outstanding graduate achievements, introducing the latest group of scholars, and persisting in preparing the future chemical industry workforce. On September 18, 2026 in Washington, the Future of STEM Scholars Initiative (FOSSI) initiated the application process for the upcoming scholar class. This initiative aims to nurture talented individuals for careers in STEM fields.

data.title: Arizona Voters Want Action, Not Just Words
data.description: A recent study conducted by Arizona Voters' Agenda revealed that voters are seeking decisive solutions, practical approaches, and actual implementation of their top concerns. The research conducted statewide showed that leading up to the General Election in Arizona, voters are looking for clear responses rather than just the stances taken by candidates. The study, conducted as of September 18, 2026, in Phoenix, highlighted the importance of addressing voter priorities effectively.
